home.suggestionsSoon: Suggestions based on your budget, dates and checklist show up here.
home.visionTitle: A hacienda courtyard, soft lights, lots of flowers and color
home.visionNote: Ideas you both love show up here.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.intro: A month-by-month plan for a Cartagena destination wedding, counted back from {{date}}. Change the date in Wedding details and every task moves with it.

budget.title: Budget
budget.intro: Lock your must-haves. When the total moves up or down, everything unlocked scales to fit.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.intro: Track every vendor from first message to final payment. Most Cartagena vendors reply fastest on WhatsApp.

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.intro: Upload photos, paste Pinterest or Google Images links, and heart the ones you love. Ideas you both heart go to the top of your vision.

guests.title: Guests
guests.intro: You're planning for {{n}} guests. Track RSVPs and who has booked travel to Cartagena.

notes.title: Notes & decisions
notes.intro: One place for what you've agreed, open questions, and anything you don't want to lose.

details.title: Wedding details
details.intro: The basics everything else is built on. Changing the date moves the whole checklist.

summary.details: Date, guest count, exchange rate, events and access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That link doesn't match a page in your planner.

auth.signInIntro: Your wedding planner for Cartagena. Sign in to see the plan.
auth.magicIntro: We’ll email you a link that signs you in, no password needed.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.useMagic: Email me a sign-in link instead
auth.inviteOnly: Only people Nick and Thuraya have invited can sign in.
auth.sentMagic: If {{email}} has been invited, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it on this device.
auth.sentReset: If {{email}} has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way.
auth.sentTip: It can take a minute or two. Check your spam folder if it doesn’t arrive.
auth.setPasswordIntro: You’re signed in as {{email}}. Choose a password so you can sign in again later.
auth.setupIntro: Nobody has set up the wedding yet. You’ll be its first owner. The plan starts with the Cartagena checklist, a $15,000 budget and your first decisions. Then you can invite Thuraya and your planner.
auth.notInvitedTitle: You’re not on the guest list yet
auth.notInvitedIntro: You’re signed in as {{email}}, but nobody has added you to the wedding. Ask Nick or Thuraya to invite you from Wedding details, then check again.

errors.wrongPassword: That email and password don’t match. Try again, or use “Forgot password?”.
errors.notInvited: That email hasn’t been invited. Ask Nick or Thuraya to invite you, or check for a typo.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.emailLimit: We can’t send more emails right now. Wait an hour and try again, or sign in with your password.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a longer password: at least 8 characters.
errors.samePassword: That’s your current password. Choose a new one.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
errors.offline: We can’t reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

members.title: People & access
members.intro: Owners can change everything. The planner can edit tasks, vendors, guests, notes and inspiration; the budget, payments, events and wedding details are view-only for them.
members.confirm: Remove {{name}}? They’ll lose access right away.
members.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove them. Check your connection and try again.
members.name: Name
members.ownerHint: Owners have full access, including the budget and inviting people.
members.plannerHint: Planners can’t change the budget, payments, events or wedding details.
members.inviteNote: They’ll get an email with a link to choose a password. If they already have an account, they’re added right away and can sign in.
members.inviteFailed: Couldn’t send the invitation. Check your connection and try again.
members.ownersOnly: Only Nick and Thuraya can invite or remove people.

result.added: {{email}} already had an account and now has access. They can sign in.

errors.offline: You’re offline, so that wasn’t saved. Reconnect and try again.
errors.denied: You don’t have permission to change that. Only Nick and Thuraya can edit the budget and wedding details.
errors.notSaved: That change couldn’t be saved, so it was undone. Try again in a moment.

budget.viewOnly: View only. Your planner can see the budget, but only Nick and Thuraya can change it.

refuse.lockedExceedTotal: That total is below your locked must-haves. Unlock a category or raise the total.
refuse.nothingUnlocked: Every category is locked, so there’s nothing to scale. Unlock one first.

budget.categoryAdded: Category added. Check the status line.
budget.name: Name
budget.noPayments: No payments yet. Add deposits as you book vendors.

vendors.contractTooBig: That file is over {{mb}} MB. Try a smaller PDF.

details.viewOnly: View only. Only Nick and Thuraya can change the date, guest count, exchange rate and events.
details.dateHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}}. Changing it moves every task by the same number of days.
details.dateSaved: Date set to {{date}}. The checklist moved with it.
details.confirmed: The date is confirmed with the venue
details.currencyIntro: Amounts are stored in US dollars. Switch the display to pesos with the USD / COP toggle at the top.
details.rateNote: Colombia’s official rate (TRM) was 3,194 on Oct 13, 2026. Update it when you pay vendors in pesos.
details.rateRange: Enter a rate between {{min}} and {{max}} pesos per dollar.
details.eventsNote: Turning an event on adds its budget lines. Rebalance in Budget if it pushes you over.
details.signOutNote: Signs you out on this device. Your plan stays saved.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Get a notification on this device when someone else adds or edits a note, adds inspiration, or checks off a task.
push.on: Notifications are on for this device.
push.off: Notifications turned off for this device.
push.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work from the Home Screen app. In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, open the planner from there, and turn this on.
push.unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications from websites. Try Safari on iPhone (from the Home Screen), or Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
push.needsNewerIos: Notifications need iOS 16.4 or later. Update your iPhone in Settings → General → Software Update.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this app. On iPhone, open Settings → Notifications → Wedding, and allow them. In a browser, allow notifications in the site settings.
push.notConfigured: Notifications aren’t set up for this site yet. The README explains how to add the keys.
push.mockOnly: Notifications work once the planner is connected to Supabase.
push.failed: Couldn’t turn on notifications. Check your connection and try again.
push.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
push.testBody: You’ll hear about new notes and inspiration here.
